title: Applying an agent definition clears existing repo instruction messages
reasoning: apply_prompt_context_to_session normalizes repo_instruction_messages from the provided argument and writes the result back to runtime.repo_instruction_messages. apply_agent_definition_to_session calls it with repo_instruction_messages=None whenever the agent definition has any prompt context, so installing or updating an agent definition on an active session drops previously applied repository instruction messages. That can remove AGENTS.md/project guidance from the prompt even though changing an agent definition should layer agent-specific context rather than erase unrelated repo context. Confidence is medium because the manager call sites are not shown, but the included code clearly performs the clear.
recommendation: When applying an agent definition, preserve the session's existing runtime.repo_instruction_messages unless the agent definition explicitly supplies replacement repo instructions. Pass getattr(runtime, 'repo_instruction_messages', None) through instead of None, or make replacement semantics explicit with a separate field.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included config-service tests only cover applying a frontend operating system and building config overrides; they do not set existing repo_instruction_messages and then apply an agent definition.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a dummy session with runtime.repo_instruction_messages populated, apply an agent definition with a workspace_path or system_prompt_override, and assert the existing repo instruction messages remain on both runtime and prompt_builder.
